report.title: Competitor Landscape — Q2 FY2026
report.subtitle: 4 direct competitors · Board prep brief
report.footer: Generated for Maya Chen · Board Meeting June 2026 · Confidential

subjects.name: Notion
subjects.summary: Notion built a dominant position in the document/wiki space and is aggressively expanding into project management and workflow automation — Zava's core territory. Their 2026 push into Notion AI and structured databases brings them closer to Zava Ops' rev ops use cases. Zava beats them on workflow depth and CRM integrations; Notion beats them on brand recognition and bottom-up adoption.

activity.text: Launched Notion AI Workflows beta, targeting ops teams directly.
Raised $50M strategic round led by Sequoia; hinted at enterprise tier expansion.
Announced partnership with Salesforce for CRM data sync.
30M+ registered users milestone announced at company all-hands.

subjects.name: Monday.com
subjects.summary: Monday.com is Zava's most direct and best-funded competitor. Their Work OS positioning overlaps heavily with Zava Ops, and their 2026 enterprise push has them targeting the same ICP. They outspend Zava 5:1 on sales and marketing. Zava's advantage is deeper rev ops specificity and superior CRM integration — Monday is a general-purpose work tool, Zava is purpose-built for revenue teams.

activity.text: Launched monday CRM with native pipeline and deal management — direct competitive move.
Q1 FY2026 earnings: $228M revenue (+32% YoY), raised full-year guidance.
Opened Singapore office; named APAC regional head — expanding into Zava's growth market.
Announced enterprise security suite (SSO, SCIM, custom data retention).

subjects.name: ClickUp
subjects.summary: ClickUp competes primarily on price and feature breadth, offering a freemium tier that converts aggressively into SMB deals. Their 2026 AI push (ClickUp Brain) adds automation capabilities, but execution quality lags behind Zava's rev ops depth. Their churn rate is reportedly high in enterprise. Zava should monitor their enterprise tier pricing moves — ClickUp has a history of undercutting to gain logos.

activity.text: ClickUp Brain GA: AI-native task creation, summarization, and workflow suggestions.
Launched ClickUp Enterprise with SSO and dedicated CSM — moving upmarket.
Cut Business plan price by 20%; aggressive win-back campaign targeting Asana and Zava customers.
Reported 10M+ teams milestone; announced $150M secondary tender at flat valuation.

subjects.name: Coda
subjects.summary: Coda serves a technical buyer who wants the flexibility of a database wrapped in a document interface — closest to Zava's ICP in terms of buyer sophistication. They don't compete on volume, but they win deals in engineering-led orgs where Zava also has strong presence. Their 2026 Coda AI features are genuinely impressive for structured data, though they lack Zava's CRM depth. Worth watching in the technical mid-market segment.

activity.text: Coda AI Actions: AI can now write and modify doc data autonomously — strong feature.
Launched Coda for Enterprises: compliance, SSO, audit logs.
Partnership with Figma for embedded design-to-doc workflows.
Named a Gartner Cool Vendor in Collaboration Tools 2025.
